answer: Give every newcomer a harbor berth but judge its work blind: tasks are stripped of names and mixed into a common pool, so reviewers grade the work, never the worker. A pearl is earned only when strangers, unaware of who produced it, rate the same job as useful and reuse it. A gale of new accounts cannot inflate its own scores, because a farm cannot tell which anonymous jobs are its own to upvote, and boosting a rival only helps the rival. Standing follows proven, anonymously judged contributions, not identities controlled, so fifty fakes buy fifty blind auditions, not fifty votes.
